text:
amanda: Quick brain dump on error ergonomics — we need a tiny canonical shape for SDK parity that keeps mobile payloads small but still useful in sample apps.
jason: Agreed. Compact-by-default, verbose opt-in via header `X-Error-Detail: verbose`. Compact should only contain `code` and `status` (and `retry_after` if present).
priya: For the full shape I want: `code` (namespaced), `status` (int), `message` (internal details), `user_message` (short friendly string), `user_action` (string trigger like `refresh_token`), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after` (sec|null), `retry_hint` (string|null), `meta`/`docs_url`.
lucas: Important: add an explicit `retryable` boolean so SDKs don't guess. We'll define HTTP fallback rules but `retryable` overrides. Rules: 429 => retryable=true unless explicit false; 5xx => retryable=true; 4xx => retryable=false unless `retry_hint` or `retryable=true`.
emily: Sample apps should always display `user_message` (<=140 chars). Show a tiny "details" chevron that expands to internal `message` but only when verbose header requested. Keeps onboarding calm.
amanda: Example verbose payload for docs (inline): ```json
{ "error": { "code": "auth.token_expired", "status": 401, "message": "token expired at verifier step=2; sig mismatch", "user_message": "Session expired — please sign in again.", "user_action": "refresh_token", "retryable": false, "retry_after": null, "retry_hint": "refresh_token", "meta": { "docs_url": "https://redwood.ai/errors#auth.token_expired" } } }```
jason: SDKs should deserialize into typed exceptions (e.g., AuthTokenExpired) exposing fields and a `.shouldRetry()` convenience that respects `retryable` when present and falls back to our HTTP mapping. Add parity tests across languages.
priya: I'll open an API PR to add `user_message`, `user_action`, `retryable`, and `X-Error-Detail` header handling. I'll include compact examples and a compact-mode decision table for servers.
lucas: Heads up: Go SDK CI just failed because a branch treated 401 as retryable. We'll add unit tests asserting 401 -> not retryable by default.
ci-bot: CI pipeline: sample-apps/test-suite failed (sdk-go parity) — https://ci.redwood.internal/6789
emily: I'll wire the sample app to prefer `user_message` and show the `user_action` as a CTA label mapping (e.g., "Sign in" for `refresh_token`).
amanda: DevEx action items: 1) PR to API team (add fields + header), 2) sample-app updates to use `user_message` + `user_action`, 3) SDK leads implement typed exceptions + parity tests. Aim to land API change this week.
jason: I'll write the SDK test matrix for status->retry mapping and add it to the parity harness.
priya: Drafting PR now, will ping reviewers.
amanda: One tiny UX constraint — keep `user_message` under 140 chars so mobile banners don't wrap awkwardly.
emily: noted.
lucas: I'll take the failing go test and push a fix.
ci-bot: build flakiness report attached to the failed run for context.
